method: For each task/version/seed, construct the verified source class independently, set the recorded team/vision/horizon, reset NumPy with seed, reset the environment, and execute up to20 actions generated by independent RandomState(903+seed). Compare reset observation, every complete step observation/reward/done/info, array dtype/shape/values, and final NumPy RNG state using canonical sort_keys JSON SHA256. Stop at natural termination.
scope: Environment-only fixed-action replay; no policies, optimizer updates, training jobs or remote actions.
